describes: Current form K/V/C/F controller transactions and native form capabilities.

cases.name: standalone-configured-environment
cases.covers: The standalone host reads the name-tree scripts once, boots once per realm with the configured file name, identity, clock, offset and seed, and returns the value effect; a second commit does not boot again.
cases.reason: Pins the script transaction (what crosses into the sandbox and what commits), through settled results, sandbox callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: standalone-default-environment
cases.covers: Without configuration the clock is the host's, the offset the host zone's, the seed seedFrom(document id, run), the file name the document's, the identity the engine's claims; a document without catalog actions boots nothing but still builds the realm.
cases.reason: Pins the script transaction (what crosses into the sandbox and what commits), through settled results, sandbox callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: standalone-identity-callback

cases.name: effects-canonicalise
cases.covers: Script effects fold into the overlay: a reset back to a default becomes one leading reset effect, a later setValue un-resets (even back to the default), display changes become setDisplay, appearance text keeps the last per field in first-set order, and effects on fields the snapshot lacks are dropped.

cases.name: native-effect-statuses
cases.covers: Native form writes use atomic ChangeResult instead of per-effect batch statuses. A no-op confirms unchanged; a successful write folds before return; each engine refusal rolls back to the confirmed value.

cases.name: no-change-is-unchanged

cases.name: batch-writes-count-rejections

cases.name: reset-recalculates
cases.covers: A reset and calculation share one atomic change, with the action origin carried to surfaced UI. Script failure cancels every requested reset.

cases.name: scripted-activation
cases.covers: Widget actions resolve from the form snapshot and dispatch JavaScript through the registered form commit sink. Missing widgets reject; tree-less widgets fall back without a page reread.
